name: primordial stone
lore_descriptor: stone older than the mountains, deep gray, veined with red, and impossibly heavy
first_pickup_chronicle: Primordial stone, older than names and heavier than seems fair. No spell will mark it and no forge will melt it. Neither will my complaining.
design_notes: Band F heavy exotic_metal. Mult 1.75 (highest in game), weight 2.0 (heaviest in game), enchant 1. Spell-resistant wielder bonus. Brute endgame counterpart to godweave's elegance.
